name: GSP Crop Science Ltd
title: GSP Crop Science Ltd - 544733 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Agrochem maker passing through crude-linked cost hikes (10-15% price increase from 1 April) with patented mix rising to ~20% of revenue; no capacity additions or utilisation trend disclosed beyond formulations at 30-40% and technicals at 70-75%.

triggers.label: Price increase 10-15% from 1 April
triggers.quote: from 1st April, we have increased the price from 10% to 15% already to the market

triggers.label: Technical utilisation 70-75%
triggers.quote: The technical plants that we have which is one at near Ahmedabad and the biggest plant which is at Nandeshari, there the capacity utilizations are in the range of 70% to 75%

triggers.label: Patented share ~20% of revenue
triggers.quote: in FY26, we've done almost 20% from these patented products

guidance.metric: Patented product revenue share in 3 years
guidance.quote: almost 40% to 50% revenue will be coming from this kind of products
this or at least higher growth rate by another 5%-7% is what we're targeting for the upcoming 3 years
we'll be coming up with such launches, one or two launches on an yearly basis

red_flags.label: Raw material supply strain if conflict extends
red_flags.quote: if this gets further prolonged by another month or so, then there could be a possibility where the supply could be impacted

red_flags.label: B2C price pass-through lag and channel inventory
red_flags.quote: there is lot of channel inventory, distributors are there, there is lot of competition in that generic market
